candidates.name: Cherubism
support_spans: painless, bony-hard swelling of the left cheek
expansion of the left maxillary ridge with mobility of primary teeth
large, well-circumscribed, expansile, heterogeneous (mixed-density) mass occupying the entire left maxillary sinus
candidates.why: The clinical and radiographic findings are consistent with Cherubism, a rare genetic disorder characterized by bilateral expansion of the jawbones.

candidates.name: Fibrous dysplasia
